questions.answer: I do, more than I expected to. A slow evening walk is one of my favourite ways to unwind, and it's good for my health too. It clears my head far more [[effectively]] than sitting in front of a screen.

questions.q: How often do you go for a walk?
questions.answer: Almost every evening, weather permitting. I usually walk for around half an hour after work. During the monsoon it's harder, but I try to keep it up, because skipping it leaves me feeling [[restless]].

questions.q: Where do you like to go for a walk?
questions.answer: My favourite spot is the embankment along the Jamuna. The breeze off the river is lovely, and the view at sunset is [[breathtaking]]. It's quite popular too, so I often bump into people I know.

questions.q: Did you walk a lot as a child?
questions.answer: Constantly. I walked to school every day with my friends, and we'd often take the long way home just to [[dawdle]] and chat. Those walks were a highlight of the day rather than a chore.

questions.q: Do you think people walk less nowadays than in the past?
questions.answer: Definitely. With rickshaws, motorbikes and ride-share apps so readily available, many people won't even walk short distances. It's a pity, because walking is such a simple way to stay fit and [[clear-headed]].
